title: claude-config installs the factory pack and deletes what moved, in one release

story.i_want_to: get the delivery-loop hooks, skills, scripts and prose from the installed factory pack and from nowhere else
story.so_that: no factory hook runs twice or from a stale copy, and a factory change needs no claude-config edit

rationale: PRD R10: claude-config installs the pack like any plugin, and session-message.sh, the nudger's ssh pokes, handoff posts and the claim-scope gate hooks retire. PRD section 4: a release that replaces a mechanism deletes the old one in that same release, so the retired items are already gone (US-52.28 in release 4, US-52.49's claude-config PR in release 7) and this release deletes what moved. Today every factory hook is wired by claude-config's settings.shared.json (merged into each machine by bin/merge-settings.py), the delivery-loop rules are prose in its CLAUDE.md:44-61, and five scripts are named there by their claude-config path. Installing the pack without deleting these would run each gate twice and leave two sources for every rule.

acceptance_criteria.description: claude-config's settings.shared.json registers the marketplace loopctl-factory (git source mkreyman/loopctl at the tag of the manifest's pack version) and enables loopctl-factory@loopctl-factory and review-round-counter@loopctl-factory, and no longer enables review-round-counter@mkreyman-plugins.

settings.shared.json names no hook file that factory/inventory.toml lists, whatever its fate: a claude-config canary (hooks/tests/factory-pack-canary.sh) reads the inventory from the installed pack and fails naming any such hook entry.

hooks/inbox-on-tool.sh and the INBOX block of hooks/session-start.sh (both US-52.28) move into the pack as factory/src/hooks/inbox-on-tool.sh (imported with history) and factory/src/hooks/inbox-on-start.sh (the block extracted as a SessionStart hook), each an inventory item of fate pack; claude-config deletes both, every other pack, generated and thin_call item with its canary under hooks/tests/, and plugins/review-round-counter.

No file in claude-config names a deleted path or tool: a grep over the repo for session-message.sh, handoff-issue.sh, fleet-nudge.sh, wait-for-checks.sh, delete-merged-branch.sh, worktree-remove.sh, channel_claim, channel_done and handoff: outside git history returns nothing except ~/.claude/factory/ references.
claude-config CLAUDE.md's 'Delivery loop (top-level sessions)' section and its 'Reach a session on another machine' bullet are replaced by the single line @~/.claude/factory/prose/delivery-loop.md.

claude-config's remaining hooks that source a lib the pack now owns (cmd-scan.sh, refusal-note.sh, effective-dir.sh, scrub.sh, mix-scan.sh, merge-scan.sh) source it from ~/.claude/factory/hooks/lib/, and bin/harness-selftest.sh exits non-zero naming the missing file when ~/.claude/factory/hooks/lib/cmd-scan.sh is absent.

The claude-config-sync skill installs or updates the pack on every FLEET_MACHINES host, runs ~/.claude/factory/bin/install-link.sh there, and reports per host the installed pack version, reporting a host failed when its version differs from the manifest's.

One merge-settings.py write both enables the pack and drops the old hook entries, so a machine synced before or after it runs each factory hook exactly once: the canary of AC-52.54.2 counts one registration per pack hook in the merged settings.json.

test_cases.name: merged settings carry the pack and one registration per pack hook (claude-config python test on merge-settings.py)
preconditions: a fixture machine settings.json from before the change, with review-round-counter@mkreyman-plugins enabled and gate-pr-body.sh wired
expected_results: marketplace loopctl-factory present; both pack plugins enabled; gate-pr-body.sh absent from hooks

test_cases.name: factory-pack canary fails on a re-added factory hook (claude-config canary)
preconditions: a fixture inventory listing gate-stated-intent.sh; settings.shared.json with it re-added

test_cases.name: no moved path survives, and the inbox hooks run from the pack (claude-config canary over the tree)
preconditions: the claude-config branch of this release
steps: for each non-retired inventory origin: test ! -e <origin>
read the pack's hooks.json SessionStart and PostToolUse entries
expected_results: no file; no inbox read left in session-start.sh; inbox-on-start.sh and inbox-on-tool.sh each registered once; no match outside ~/.claude/factory/ references

test_cases.name: CLAUDE.md imports the pack prose (claude-config canary)
steps: grep the CLAUDE.md headings and the import line
expected_results: no 'Delivery loop' heading; exactly one @~/.claude/factory/prose/delivery-loop.md line

test_cases.name: selftest goes red without the pack libs (claude-config canary)
preconditions: HOME set to a tmp dir with ~/.claude/factory missing

test_cases.name: sync reports a host on the wrong pack version (integration, sync script against two hosts with stubbed ssh)
preconditions: stubbed ssh returning pack version 1.0.0 from one host and the manifest's version from the other
expected_results: the first host reported failed with both versions; the second ok

technical_notes: Cross-repo: this story's code change is a mkreyman/claude-config PR, opened by the implementer through claude-config's own delivery loop (it is branch-protected). It merges after the loopctl epic merges and the pack tag exists, because AC-52.54.1 pins that tag; until it merges, the fleet keeps running claude-config's copies, and the epic's e2e (US-52.55) runs on the pack alone.

Settings to edit: /home/mkreyman/workspace/claude-config/settings.shared.json marketplace block :34-41 and enabledPlugins :42-53 (review-round-counter@mkreyman-plugins at :47); hook entries named in US-52.52's technical notes (:153, :198, :203, :211, :285, :289, :299, :331, :395, :404, :446, :590, :594, :598); the retired entries (channel-push-on-prompt.sh :520 by US-52.28; gate-claimed-handoff.sh :236, warn-claimed-handoff.sh :529, block-handoff-placeholder.sh :232, gate-channel-claim-scope.sh :342 by US-52.49's claude-config PR; block-channel-scope-bypass.sh :228, gate-claimed-dispatch.sh :282, gate-channel-naming.sh :351 with them) are gone before this release, and AC-52.54.2's canary keeps them gone. merge-settings.py REPLACES the hooks block (its $comment, :2), so deleting an entry here removes it on every machine at the next sync.

CLAUDE.md: /home/mkreyman/workspace/claude-config/CLAUDE.md:44-61 (section) and :31 (bullet); :30's fleet-resume.sh is not factory and stays. The @-import form is the one this file already uses for SOUL.md and USER.md (:7, :9).

Libs the pack owns after US-52.50, still sourced by claude-config hooks: cmd-scan.sh, refusal-note.sh and effective-dir.sh (e.g. block-complex-bash.sh, block-foreign-repo-write.sh), scrub.sh and mix-scan.sh, merge-scan.sh (nudge-deploy-after-merge.sh); the implementer greps hooks/ for each at branch cut. They keep their '|| exit 0' guards, so a machine without the pack fails open, and harness-selftest.sh (bin/harness-selftest.sh) is what turns that red.

claude-config-sync: /home/mkreyman/workspace/claude-config/skills/claude-config-sync/SKILL.md and FLEET_MACHINES in hooks/lib/fleet-name.sh; the pack install uses claude plugin marketplace update loopctl-factory then claude plugin install, per host over the ssh the skill already uses.

Skills and commands that moved (skills/shepherd, skills/agent-spec-builder, skills/handoff, commands/fleet.md, commands/triage-trio.md, agents/triage-*.md) are deleted here; the pack provides them under the same names, so a typed /triage-trio or a shepherd trigger keeps working.

The loopctl skills hand-copied into claude-config (skills/loopctl-plan etc. against this repo's skills/loopctl-*.md) are outside PRD R10's list and are not touched; recorded as a candidate for the pack in the report, not built here.

The nudger's systemd or launchd timer is reinstalled from the pack path by fleet-orchestrator.sh start, run by the sync on each host; the old unit pointing at claude-config/bin is removed by the same run.

Inbox hooks: the INBOX block US-52.28 put in place of hooks/session-start.sh's TEAM CHANNEL block (:406-703 today) is cut out into factory/src/hooks/inbox-on-start.sh with its credential-file read and nonce-fenced render, inventory origin hooks/session-start.sh; inbox-on-tool.sh is imported with git filter-repo like US-52.50's items. Both join factory/inventory.toml so US-52.50's check stays green, and US-52.52's generated hooks.json registers them.
non_goals: Moving claude-config's personal half (SOUL.md, USER.md, marketing, learning and KB-mining skills, general hygiene hooks): PRD non-goals.
Fetching the pack from a private repo with a token: release 11 (README releases table).
Proving a pack-only session end to end: US-52.55.

failure_modes.partition: AC-52.54.7: a host the sync cannot reach is reported failed with its current pack version, and keeps running whichever complete set (old copies or pack) it last synced, never a mix (AC-52.54.8).
failure_modes.state: AC-52.54.2: which hooks run is decided by the pack's inventory and claude-config's settings.shared.json, both under version control, and the canary fails when they overlap.
failure_modes.retry: AC-52.54.8: the settings merge writes the same file on every run and install-link.sh is idempotent, so re-running the sync changes nothing on a synced host.
failure_modes.slow: AC-52.54.7: the sync reports each host separately, so one slow host delays only its own line, inside the sync skill's existing per-host ssh timeout.
failure_modes.reach: AC-52.54.7: the pack reaches each machine through Claude Code's plugin installer, driven by claude-config-sync over ssh to every FLEET_MACHINES host.

defaults: Marketplace source: git, github.com/mkreyman/loopctl, pinned to the tag of the manifest's pack version.
Shared libs are owned by the pack; claude-config sources them from ~/.claude/factory/hooks/lib/ (owner may prefer a copy in each repo).
definition_of_done: On every FLEET_MACHINES host after sync: claude plugin list shows loopctl-factory at the manifest's version, and grep -c gate-stated-intent ~/.claude/settings.json is 0 while the pack's hooks.json registers it once.
In a fresh session on minis: /triage-trio and the shepherd skill are listed, and ~/.claude/factory/bin/wait-for-checks.sh --help exits 0.
